The signed accumulation is proved for the drive schedule the design specifies; the sequencer that produces it, the pin wrapper and the fabric glue are hand-written RTL and are not part of either proof.

projects.title: ultrasonic sonar: range and bearing
projects.author: SiliconSonics
projects.description: Digital sonar processor. Drives a 40 kHz ultrasonic transducer, demodulates the returning echo from two PDM microphones with square-wave I/Q correlators, and reports echo distance and bearing on parallel pins and over a 115200 baud UART. projects.title: Hardware Audio Tempo Detector
projects.author: Taiwo Opesade
projects.description: Detects the tempo (BPM) of a live audio stream entirely in hardware, using onset detection and a bit-serial divider - no CPU, no multiplier.

pinout.uio[0]: sample_valid - strobe: a new audio_sample is present this cycle
pinout.uio[2]: beat_pulse - one-cycle pulse on each detected beat onset
pinout.uio[3]: tempo_locked - high once recent intervals are stable
pinout.uio[5]: overflow_flag - no beat seen recently (silence / very slow)
pinout.uio[6]: confidence[0] - stability score, bit 0 (2'b11 = tightest lock)

projects.title: UNDIP ANN Accelerator (SPI + bring-up self-test)
projects.author: Muhammad Ardi Saputro; Dr. Munawar Agus Riyadi
projects.description: Feedforward ANN accelerator (4-5-1 topology, Q6.10 activation, Q4.4 weight) with SPI interface, weight-load separated from input-load, and bring-up modes (heartbeat/loopback/self-test) via a mode-select pin

pinout.uo[1]: ann result bit15 (normal) / heartbeat toggle / echo ui[1] (loopback) / self_test_done (selftest)
pinout.uo[2]: ann result bit14 (normal) / 0 / echo ui[2] (loopback) / self_test_pass (selftest)
pinout.uio[0]: debug: axis_tvalid (deserializer->ann), active in normal mode only
pinout.uio[1]: debug: axis_tready, active in normal mode only
pinout.uio[2]: debug: axis_tlast, active in normal mode only
pinout.uio[3]: debug: m_axis_tvalid (ann->serializer), active in normal mode only
pinout.uio[4]: debug: m_axis_tready, active in normal mode only
pinout.uio[5]: status: weights_loaded (active in all modes, 1 = weight/bias loaded at least once since reset)
